body.x: With the support from Gyeonggi ContentAgency, M2S will participate in the world’s largest technology exhibition CES2020 opening in Las Vegas on Jan. 7-10 to showcase its VR eye examinationdevice.
M2S is a world-renowned VR and AR contents production company. Based on these technologies and capabilities, the company has launched VR eye examination devices in the medical and healthcare fields.

The official said, “As you know, eye health is deteriorating due to increased use of electronic devices and air pollution (fine dust). As aging progresses, the eyes also deteriorate. Our society is getting older. For these reasons, eye diseases and diseases are growing rapidly.” He continued, “For this reason, the market for ophthalmic medical devices will be much larger than it is today, and the United States accounts for more than 40% of the global market for medical devices and healthcare. This is why we are participating in CES 2020 in the United States.”
M2S has integrated VR technology intomedical devices, which is suitable for industry 4.0. The existing inspectionprotocol was newly developed as VR contents.

Traditional medical devices are analog-type, while the product developed by this company is entirely digital. It also saves time, space, manpower, and unit cost. All information and results will be combined with AI, big data and applications. The data is also expected to be used in hospitals, insurance companies, clinics and even personal mobile applications.
M2S has participated in GITEX 2019, the biggest trade show in the Middle East, with the invitation of Etisalat.

Gyeonggi Content Agency is the agency established with the mission to “create future value" by the integration of the contents, people, and technology in Gyeonggi area. G-HUB, Gyeonggi Global Game Center, Gyeonggi Contents Korea Lab, Export Support System, and Gyeonggi Film Commission are part of the team. The CES 2020 SME participation support is one of the contents-based technology companies' export support programs. Companies that are proven to be competitive more than twice are selected for participation.

The world’s largest IT show CES shows the trend of the global consumer electronics industry at a glance. It is hosted by Consumer Technology Association (CTA) and is held every January. AVING NEWS has reported the most news on CES, MWC, and IFA, the world's three major tech exhibitions for the past 13 years. It is sending special reporters to CES this year to report major issues in the global market and introduce outstanding Korean companies to the world.
